title: Chevrolet 3100 Engines by Year (1947–1959)
description: Every factory engine in the Chevrolet 3100 half-ton pickup by year, 1947–1959: the 216 and 235 Thriftmaster sixes and the 265 and 283 Trademaster V8s.
intro: The 3100 was Chevrolet's half-ton pickup through the Advance Design and Task Force years, including the Cameo Carrier and the 1958–1959 Apache 31. 1955 had two series: the Advance Design truck early in the year and the Task Force truck from March. Later half-tons are on the C/K pickup page.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: Advance Design
intro: The 216 Thriftmaster six, replaced by the 235 for 1954. The 1955 first-series trucks kept the 235.

generations.name: Task Force
intro: The 235 six and Chevrolet's first V8 truck option: the 265 from the 1955 second series, then the 283 for 1958.
